Now .env.dev exists as a file. Note the .env.dev uses DB_HOST=localhost, which is wrong inside the app container, but the app container sets GEOSPATIAL_ANALYZER_DB_HOST=db as environment variable. However, ConfigModule loads .env.dev into process.env... does dotenv override existing env vars? No, by default dotenv does not override existing process.env variables. And docker-compose environment vars are in process.env. But ConfigModule.loadEnvFile uses dotenv which doesn't override. Actually NestJS ConfigModule assigns to process.env but doesn't override existing. So db should win. Let me restart.
